notes: One record per card, keyed by Scryfall `oracle_id`: a front-face name is not an identifier, so a name key moves every card that answers to it (review finding D1). `name` is an assertion, not data — the run fails when an `oracleId` no longer names the card written beside it. `why` is the curation rationale. `plane` is an Appendix A slug. PRD 11.9 orders the curation work; a record that matches no first printing is listed in the run report rather than applied.
